pages.description: Practical survival gear guides and emergency preparedness checklists for blackouts, disasters and extended disruptions.

pages.title: Survival gear catalogue | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: Compare emergency equipment by power, water, shelter and protective needs. Read specifications, plan a kit and check Canadian retailer variants.

pages.title: Blackout: Grid failure | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: Practical preparedness for extended electrical outages: power, lighting, radios, communication and household planning.

pages.title: Fallout: Disaster response | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: Responsible disaster and crisis preparedness: evacuation bags, water, food, first aid, shelter and household plans.

pages.title: Outbreak: Field readiness | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: Equipment profiles for evacuation, outdoor travel and practical protection. Plan your load, understand each item’s limits and follow the manufacturer instructions.

pages.title: 3M 2091 P100 Particulate Filters: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: P100 particulate filters for approved 3M bayonet assemblies. The documented Canadian offer advertises one pair (two filters). The 2091 is distinct from 2097 and has no documented nuisance-level organic-vapor relief.

pages.title: 3M 2097 P100 Particulate Filters: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: P100 particulate filters with limited nuisance-level organic-vapor relief. The documented Canadian offer advertises five pairs (ten filters); check the selected pack and approved use.

pages.title: 3M 60921 Organic Vapor/P100 Cartridge Filters: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: Cartridge/filter components for certain organic vapors and P100 particulates. The documented Canadian offer advertises one pair; approved selection, fit and use limits remain essential.

pages.title: 3M 60926 Multi-Gas/Vapor P100 Cartridge Filters: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: P100 cartridge/filter components for gases and vapors specified by 3M. The documented Canadian offer advertises one pair; this is not universal chemical protection.

pages.title: 3M 6800 Full Facepiece Reusable Respirator: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A medium reusable full facepiece with a clear lens and bayonet filter connections. The facepiece alone does not filter air; hazard selection, compatible approved components and a tight fit are essential.

pages.title: 3M Aura 9205+ N95 particulate respirator: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A disposable particulate respirator documented by 3M as N95. Correct selection, fit and genuine supply matter; this is not protection against gases, vapours or oxygen deficiency.

pages.title: 3M GoggleGear 500 protective goggles: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: Low-profile protective goggles, documented here against the clear GG501SGAF reference. The actual lens markings, Canadian variant and suitability for the task must be checked.

pages.title: 5.11 Tactical RUSH72 2.0 55 L backpack: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A large compartmentalized pack for an evacuation load or a planned multi-day outing. Its 55 L capacity is a manufacturer specification, not a guarantee of comfortable carrying weight.

pages.h1: BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 — 200 W Solar Offer
pages.title: BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 — 200 W Solar Offer: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A 1024 Wh LiFePO4 station with 1800 W rated AC output, linked to an owner-reported 200 W solar offer. Confirm the panel model and connecting cables before purchase.

pages.h1: Datrex DX2400F Emergency Food Ration — 2400 Calories
pages.title: Datrex DX2400F Emergency Food Ration — 2400 Calories: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A compact ready-to-eat ration documented as twelve 200-kcal bars: 2,400 kcal for the complete packet. Contains wheat; check the delivered ingredients, seals, dates and Canadian pack quantity.

pages.title: EcoFlow DELTA 2 Portable Power Station: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A 1024 Wh LiFePO4 station with 1800 W rated AC output for a measured blackout load plan. Solar panels and extra batteries are not established as part of this offer.

pages.title: EcoFlow RIVER 2 Pro: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A 768 Wh LiFePO4 power station with 800 W rated AC output for lights, communications and a carefully limited set of essential devices.

pages.title: ESEE-4 Fixed Blade Knife: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A compact fixed-blade reference for campsite cutting and field repairs. The selected configuration has a black blade, gray handle and black sheath with belt attachment; confirm the exact steel and package on the selected offer.

pages.title: Fenix CL26R Pro rechargeable lantern: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A rechargeable lantern with area, downward and red lighting modes for shared rooms, work surfaces and a portable blackout lighting kit.

pages.title: Fenix HM50R V2.0 rechargeable headlamp: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A compact rechargeable headlamp for hands-free outage tasks, with white and red light and a removable lamp body. Battery revision and Canadian listing remain to be matched.

pages.title: FNIRSI GC-01 Geiger Counter: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A portable Geiger-counter reference for certain ionising radiation. The upper measurement limit is not established here, and this instrument cannot certify food, water or an area as safe.

pages.title: Garmin GPSMAP 67i satellite communicator: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A handheld navigation device with inReach satellite communication. Messaging and satellite SOS require a compatible active subscription, activation and suitable operating conditions.

pages.title: Gerber StrongArm Fixed Blade Knife: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A full-tang outdoor utility knife for camp repairs and controlled cutting tasks. The selected reference pairs a black plain-edge blade with a coyote brown grip and sheath; match the selected Canadian offer before buying.

pages.h1: INIU P62 20000 mAh 65 W power bank
pages.title: INIU P62 20000 mAh 65 W power bank: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A USB-C power bank marketed at 20000 mAh and 65 W, documented by the manufacturer as P62-E1. The exact Canadian listing configuration and safety evidence remain unverified.

pages.title: Jackery Explorer 1000 v2: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A 1070 Wh LiFePO4 power station with 1500 W rated AC output for a planned mix of lights, communications and compatible household loads.

pages.title: Jackery Explorer 300: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: The original Explorer 300 is a small lithium-ion station with a 300 W AC ceiling; its revision needs checking before purchase.

pages.title: Jackery SolarSaga 100 W Air: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A folding 100 W solar panel for weather-dependent charging. Match the station, connector and regional cable before building a backup-power kit.

pages.title: Kidde C3010 carbon monoxide alarm: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A sealed-battery carbon monoxide alarm in the C3010 family. Canadian certification and equivalence to C3010-CA have not been established for this listing.

pages.title: Leatherman Wave+ multi-tool: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: An 18-function folding multi-tool for small repairs and kit maintenance. Match the finish and included accessories, and use suitable tools for electrical or high-load work.

pages.title: Marmot PreCip rain jacket: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A PreCip-family rain shell for an outdoor weather layer. The exact generation, size and colour are unverified; Eco reference features are kept separate from claims about the selected listing.

pages.title: Mechanix Wear M-Pact work gloves: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: Work gloves with protective panels for selected impact and abrasion tasks. The black/grey model is the intended reference; size, generation and supplied performance label remain unverified.

pages.h1: Merrell Moab 3 Mid Waterproof hiking boots
pages.title: Merrell Moab 3 Mid Waterproof hiking boots: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: Mid-height waterproof hiking boots for men, with Beluga selected by the owner. Fit, width and the size-specific ASIN need checking; no size availability is promised.

pages.title: Midland ER310 emergency radio: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: An AM/FM emergency radio with rechargeable, AA, hand-crank and supplementary solar power options. Canadian Weatheradio coverage is no longer available.

pages.h1: Morakniv Garberg BlackBlade Carbon Steel Survival Kit
pages.title: Morakniv Garberg BlackBlade Carbon Steel Survival Kit: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A carbon-steel bushcraft reference with a sheath-mounted survival kit. Morakniv documents kit 13915 with a polymer sheath, ferro rod, diamond sharpener and reflective cord; confirm the selected retailer package before purchase.

pages.title: NANUK 904 first aid kit: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A compact hard-case first aid kit for organized supplies. The exact Canadian fill, expiry dates and suitability for your needs must be checked; the case alone does not establish medical readiness.

pages.h1: ReadyWise 84 Servings Gluten-Free Emergency Food Supply Bucket
pages.title: ReadyWise 84 Servings Gluten-Free Emergency Food Supply Bucket: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: One gluten-free bucket with 84 labelled servings across four recipes. ReadyWise declares 15,420 kcal, corroborated by the inspected yogurt-dessert label version; servings are not complete meals.

pages.title: Reliance Aqua-Tainer 7-gallon water container: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A rigid water-storage container with a reversible spigot and vent cap. Plan safe filling, cleaning and lifting; storage alone does not make contaminated water drinkable.

pages.h1: Royale Velour Plush & Thick Toilet Paper
pages.title: Royale Velour Plush & Thick Toilet Paper: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: An everyday bathroom-tissue supply for a household emergency shelf. The documented pack contains 12 physical rolls; 12 equals 24 is a regular-roll equivalence claim, not 24 physical rolls.

pages.h1: Sawyer Squeeze SP129 water filtration system
pages.title: Sawyer Squeeze SP129 water filtration system: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A squeeze filter for appropriate fresh-water sources, with a cleanable hollow-fibre membrane. It is not a solution for chemical contamination, salt water or every microbiological hazard.

pages.h1: SOL Emergency Bivvy with rescue whistle
pages.title: SOL Emergency Bivvy with rescue whistle: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: A compact reflective emergency bivvy for a temporary weather barrier. It is not an insulated sleeping system or a guarantee against hypothermia; confirm the size and package variant.

pages.title: S.O.S. Emergency Food Rations — 3600 Calories: specs, uses & limitations | ApocalypseGearLab
pages.description: Two packets of ready-to-eat emergency rations sold under the '3600 Calorie' designation. Check the delivered labels, seals and dates; no exact energy total is claimed for the lot.
